title: Vulkan support broken at v1.8.0
body:
Hey, just built whisper.cpp v1.8.0 with Vulkan support and it does not detect by AMD GPU (ROCM driver, integrated graphics).

When I do switch back and build v1.7.6 - it works correctly.

comments.author: participant6
comments.body: This is about the integrated GPU device type, I assume whisper.cpp is not set up yet to use it.

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
> This is about the integrated GPU device type, I assume whisper.cpp is not set up yet to use it.

Whisper 1.7.6 perfectly work on my Windows, Intel Core iGPU with Vulkan. Whisper 1.8.0 have problems, log in previous post.
On the same laptop, latest llama.cpp,  a Vulkan setup also perfectly works with the iGPU.

comments.author: participant6
comments.body: I know, before the abovementioned commit, iGPUs were marked as regular GPUs. Afterwards, they show up as integrated in the GGML API, that's the change. This was done to make device selection in llama.cpp easier, where you often have to pick from multiple devices. I'll look into what whisper is doing, should be an easy fix.
